roster_grade.headline: 17-3 heading into Week 11, most points, #1 in title odds. RB is still the only soft spot: Shough is now the bench QB, so turn him into Jeremiyah Love before the playoffs
roster_grade.window_explanation: #1 composite title odds going into Week 11: #1 by record (17-3), #1 in points for (1,504), #3 by roster value. That's a win-now team. Keep every producing starter (Mahomes, Nix, McCaffrey, Henry, Javonte, Hubbard, Higgins, Parker Washington, DeVonta Smith, Loveland) and spend true surplus (Shough, Jalon Daniels, Malik Washington, Kamara, spare picks) on the one real need: an aging RB room (need 0.4, aging 1.0).

strengths.label: Best record and most points
strengths.detail: 17-3 with 1,504 points for. Three games clear of Buck-ee's (14-6) and four clear of the 13-7 group (Rolling Ball, dickcole2410, Phil's). 134 points ahead of dickcole2410 (1,370) for the PF lead.

strengths.label: Three startable QBs
strengths.detail: Mahomes and Bo Nix start with Tyler Shough (3,446) on the bench and Jalon Daniels behind him. Superflex starts two, so Shough is the trade chip. QB need is 0.0.

strengths.label: WRs are producing above their offenses
strengths.detail: Higgins (CIN +4.9 vs Vegas) and Parker Washington (JAX +5.1) start with DeVonta Smith, and Christian Watson (4,164) sits on the bench. WR need is 0.0.

strengths.label: TE is set
strengths.detail: Colston Loveland (4,058) starts with Hockenson and Gunnar Helm behind him. TE need is 0.0.

weaknesses.label: Aging RB room
weaknesses.detail: McCaffrey (30), Henry (32), Javonte (26), Hubbard (27), and Kamara (31) are all Declining. RB need is 0.4 with an aging score of 1.0, the only real need on the roster.

weaknesses.label: Thin RB depth for the playoffs
weaknesses.detail: RJ Harvey is still on IR, so one RB injury puts Kamara (1,039) or a taxi rookie in the lineup.

weaknesses.label: Hot offenses will cool
weaknesses.detail: McCaffrey's San Francisco is 5.8 a game over Vegas, Parker Washington's Jacksonville 5.1, Higgins' Cincinnati 4.9. Expect some regression; all three stay holds for the title run.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: Sell Tyler Shough to Undefeated In My Dreams (1-19, Long shot, selling, Dart on IR): Shough + Malik Washington for Jeremiyah Love (4,608 for 4,513). Ask for Omarion Hampton in the same deal by adding DeVonta Smith + Zavion Thomas. Keep Mahomes, Nix, and every producing starter.

QB.commentary: Mahomes and Nix start (Nix gets 25.5 implied vs LV this week). Shough is the bench chip; Daniels is the backup once Shough is gone. Mahomes is off limits.

RB.commentary: McCaffrey, Javonte, Henry, and Hubbard start, but all are Declining and Harvey is on IR. This is the position to upgrade (need 0.4). Javonte has the best matchup this week (31.0 implied vs TEN).

WR.commentary: Higgins, Parker Washington, and DeVonta Smith start with Watson on the bench. Philadelphia is only 17.0 implied vs PIT this week, so if Watson is healthy he's the better start over Smith.

TE.commentary: Loveland is the TE1 (30.0 implied vs NO) with Hockenson and Helm as depth.

trade_priority_order: Tyler Shough + Malik Washington → Jeremiyah Love (Undefeated In My Dreams, 1-19, Long shot, selling, Dart on IR).

Bundle version: Shough + Malik Washington + DeVonta Smith + Zavion Thomas → Jeremiyah Love + Omarion Hampton (Chargers 4.5 a game under Vegas, the top buy-low at your need). Only if Watson is healthy to take Smith's spot.
2027 2nd + 2028 2nd + Jack Bech → Breece Hall (Bijan Mustard, 5-15, Long shot, selling). Picks are currency for a 17-3 team.
Sell Kamara to Rolling Ball (13-7, weak at RB, buying) for a 2027 3rd once one of the RBs above lands.
All-in alternative to the Love deal: Shough + Javonte Williams + 2027 2nd + 2028 3rd → Bijan Robinson (Bijan Mustard, weak at QB).
Hold Mahomes, Nix, McCaffrey, Henry, Hubbard, Loveland, and the starting WRs. You're 17-3.

sell_now.reason: On the bench behind Mahomes and Nix, worth 3,446 and flagged as QB surplus. Superflex rebuilders pay for a starting QB.
Bench WR who evens out the Shough-for-Love deal and helps their weak WR room.

sell_now.urgency: This week, if Watson is healthy
sell_now.reason: Weakest starting WR (2,644) with Watson (4,164) available on the bench. Philadelphia is 3.5 a game under Vegas and only 17.0 implied this week.
31-year-old bench RB whose value only drops, but he's the top healthy RB backup while Harvey is on IR.

buy_now.reason: 1-19 Long shot, flagged as selling, with Dart on IR. A starting QB and a WR fill their two biggest holes.
Same seller, weak at WR. The Chargers are 16.0 a game against a 20.5 Vegas average, so Hampton's price is depressed.
5-15 Long shot, flagged as selling. A 25-year-old starter for picks you don't need in a title run.
The all-in, as an alternative to the Love deal. They're weak at QB, so Shough headlines it. Mahomes, Nix, McCaffrey, and Henry all stay.

do_not_trade: Bo Nix (starting QB once Shough is sold)
Christian McCaffrey (starting RB on a 17-3 team)
Tee Higgins / Parker Washington / Christian Watson (core WRs)
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: You're 17-3, so picks are currency. Spend the two 2027 2nds and the 2028 2nd/3rd closing RB deals. Hold the extra 2028 1st unless it lands Bijan or Love outright.

outlook.projected_power_rank: #1 composite title odds (#1 record, #1 PF, #3 value). Top seed if the lineup holds.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Win now with the Mahomes/Nix/McCaffrey/Loveland/WR core. Adding a young RB this season (Love, Hampton, Hall, or Bijan) also covers 2027, when McCaffrey, Henry, and Kamara age out.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters are 17-3 heading into Week 11: best record, most points (1,504), and #1 in title odds. The only real need is an aging RB room. Shough, a bench WR, and spare picks can buy a younger RB from one of the Long shot sellers without weakening the lineup.
key_risks: Regression: McCaffrey, Parker Washington, and Higgins are on offenses scoring ~5 a game over Vegas
An RB injury, with Harvey still on IR
Rolling Ball (13-7, weak at RB, buying) is competing for the same sellers' RBs
key_upside_factors: Landing Love, Hampton, Hall, or Bijan turns RB into a strength for the playoffs
Javonte (31.0 implied vs TEN) and Loveland (30.0 vs NO) have big Week 11 matchups
Stribling and Harvey coming back from IR add depth

13-7 but Bubble on points (1,115) and built like a rebuilder. Treat as a playoff team, not a seller.
